lead: Meta rose about 3.4% to $609.89 on a day the Nasdaq sank as much as 4.6% intraday (hot October PCE, a new tariff plan, AI selling) before closing down 0.62%, after Fortune reported Amazon and Meta are in talks to let Meta's Muse AI shopping agent back onto Amazon two months after Amazon blocked it.
why: Amazon talks: Fortune reported Amazon and Meta have met several times about a deal that would let Muse, Meta's AI shopping agent, shop on Amazon again; Amazon blocked it in September, saying unauthorized AI agents break its Conditions of Use. Sticking points are search results and ads (Muse shops without seeing Amazon's ads, a $68.6B-a-year business, nearly 10% of revenue). Any deal would likely need both CEOs' sign-off; talks are fluid, no date (Fortune via The Next Web; Stocktwits via Yahoo).

Muse momentum: Muse handled 51% of AI-agent orders in the week to Nov 22 (Forter via CNBC, cited by The Next Web); 10M+ US/Canada users had set it up by Oct 21. Context: Meta still ~22% under its Sept 24 record $777.59 (JournalArta). Close figure single-sourced (The Company Chronicle +3.4%; TradingKey says +3.04%).

Market: S&P 500 -0.25% (7,182.78), Nasdaq -0.62% (23,585.80, intraday low -4.6%), Dow +0.33% (50,182.95) after October PCE 3.8% (core 3.3%, 0.1 pt above forecast), a December Fed hike almost fully priced, and proposed Section 301 tariffs up to 20%. Apple +0.4%, Microsoft -1.25%, Alphabet -2.1%, Amazon -3.1% (The Company Chronicle; Vista). Tesla/SpaceX special committees on a possible ~$3.5T all-stock merger (FT, Nov 24). Markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving.

sources.title: Amazon and Meta in talks to end the Muse blockade, Fortune reports (The Next Web)
